crossRefs.note: The disciples said to him, “Where should we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”
Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”
Moses said, “The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, ‘I will give them…
Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?
Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide…
But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth…
He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”
His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”
He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”
But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish…
Jesus therefore lifting up his eyes, and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we…

translations.web: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”
translations.bsb: “We have here only five loaves of bread and two fish,” they answered.
translations.kjv: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
translations.asv: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
